questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the roadway. It is often posted at the end of one-way streets. When you see this sign, stop and turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be ready for vehicles to merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic lights to tell drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be prepared for oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you to drive carefully in work zones. Penalties for traffic violations are doubled in construction areas to protect workers and drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. Only turn when the signal indicates it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. You cannot go straight in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a fire station nearby. Watch for emergency vehicles leaving the station and be prepared to pull over if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Drivers should watch for children and pedestrians. You must obey any instructions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that a bridge ahead has narrow lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal driving route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed.

Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on yellow backgrounds. They warn you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait until the road is clear before you proceed.

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.
